governance_note: Every field must be resolved to VERIFIED, DECLARED, INFERRED, or NOT_AVAILABLE. Missing fields must remain NOT_AVAILABLE — never inferred as TRUE.

evidence_status_taxonomy.VERIFIED: Directly confirmed via physical measurement, cryptographic hash, or independent witness.
evidence_status_taxonomy.DECLARED: Reported by site operator or source provider without independent verification.
evidence_status_taxonomy.INFERRED: Estimated from other available data. Must not be used as ground truth in any evaluation.
evidence_status_taxonomy.NOT_AVAILABLE: No evidence of any kind exists.

checklist_items.description: Unique identifier for the external facility.
Confirmation the facility is a distinct building from Facility Central 01.
Date of footage capture (YYYY-MM-DD).
Unique session identifier independent from all V3.3.x sessions.
List of camera hardware IDs used in the recording.
Original filename(s) of raw video files.
SHA-256 hash of each raw video file before any processing.
Actual duration of each recording in seconds.
Total number of frames in each recording.
Frames per second (actual, not target).
Actual resolution (WxH pixels).
Video codec used for recording.
Physical mounting height in meters (measured, not planned).
Camera pitch angle in degrees (measured, not planned).
Camera roll angle in degrees (measured, not planned).
Illuminance measurement in lux or documented lighting condition.
Ground survey fiducials or floor plan with measurement reference.
Whether frame-level bounding box annotations are available.
Annotator identification and review protocol.
Result of SHA-256 and perceptual fingerprint comparison against V3.3.x datasets.

metadata_overclaim_prohibition.rule: Metadata alone does not generate performance claims.
metadata_overclaim_prohibition.rationale: Metadata establishes provenance. Performance claims require empirical evaluation with ground truth.
